project.name: Prismatic MCP Server
project.tagline: Research-only, loopback-only, compile-gated Model Context Protocol server embedded in this OpenTTD fork
project.status_summary: A real, compiling, connectable read-only vertical, plus one gated mutation (game.set_pause via a two-phase digest-bound approval). See 05-implementation-plan.md for the honest per-phase status. Native GUI, a broader action catalogue, company scoping, autonomous multiplayer lab, and full conformance evidence are staged, not implemented.

cta.label: Get started: Prismatic MCP for contributors
cta.subtext: Research-only · loopback-only · compile-gated. Read AGENTS.md before touching anything.

getting_started_steps.title: Read the ground rules first
getting_started_steps.detail: AGENTS.md (vendor-neutral ground rules for any agent/contributor working in this fork), then CLAUDE.md.

getting_started_steps.title: Read the MCP research trail
getting_started_steps.detail: research/prismatic-mcp/README.md is the entry point; 00-baseline.md through 19-continuation-runbook.md are phase-ordered.

getting_started_steps.title: Configure with the feature gate ON
getting_started_steps.detail: OPTION_PRISMATIC_MCP_SERVER defaults OFF and requires OPTION_RESEARCH_INSTRUMENTATION=ON.

getting_started_steps.title: Run the unit tests
getting_started_steps.detail: Catch2 tests for the security-critical helpers (digest binding, auth parsing, constant-time compare) are ctest-discoverable.
getting_started_steps.command: cmake --build build-mcp --target openttd_test -j$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu) && ctest --test-dir build-mcp -R prismatic --output-on-failure

getting_started_steps.title: Start the server and connect
getting_started_steps.detail: In the in-game console: prismatic_mcp start, then prismatic_mcp token to get the bearer token. Never share the token; it is never logged.

getting_started_steps.title: Run the local validation gate before proposing a change

known_limitations: Native GUI (toolbar entry, Control Center window) is not implemented -- console command parity only.

Exactly one mutating action type is implemented: game.set_pause, via a two-phase digest-bound approval (openttd.decision.submit -> console 'prismatic_mcp approve <id>' -> execute). No company-scoped authorization, no action budget, no other action types exist yet.
This catalog itself has no automated freshness check against the actual doc_index file list beyond what tools/check-prismatic-docs.sh diffs -- new docs must be added here by hand.
